summary: Shengfeng Development Limited, a Cayman Islands exempted company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of an extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement. The meeting is scheduled for August 25, 2026 (Beijing time) to consider a 15-for-1 share consolidation (reverse split) of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, conditional on Nasdaq acceptance, effective September 4, 2026. Fractional shares would be rounded up. The company will also adopt amended and restated memorandum and articles of association. This filing supersedes the July 28, 2026 proxy materials. The board recommends approval. This is a routine reverse-split proposal to meet listing requirements, not a special situation.
